units.literal: Chang issued an edict ordering rear headquarters and each garrison to install academicians without abolishing them, examine excellence and defect, and promote according to talent.

units.zh: 苻登驃騎將軍沒奕于率戶六千降，拜使持節、車騎將軍、高平公。
units.en: Fu Deng's General of Agile Cavalry Moyifu brought six thousand households over and earned credentials as chariot-and-cavalry general and duke of Gaoping.
units.literal: Fu Deng's General of Agile Cavalry Moyifu led six thousand households to surrender and was appointed credential-bearing inspector, General of Chariots and Cavalry, and Duke of Gaoping.

units.zh: 萇寢疾，遣姚碩德鎮李潤，尹緯守長安，召其太子興詣行營。
units.en: Bedridden, he stationed Shuode at Lirun, Yin Wei in Chang'an, and called Xing to camp.
units.literal: Chang fell gravely ill; he sent Yao Shuode to hold Lirun, Yin Wei to guard Chang'an, and summoned crown prince Xing to field headquarters.

units.zh: 征南姚方成言於興曰：「今寇賊未滅，上復寢疾，王統、苻胤等皆有部曲，終為人害，宜盡除之。」
units.en: Yao Fangcheng urged Xing, "Enemies remain and your father ails—Fu Yin and Wang Tong still command bodies of retainers; purge them."
units.literal: General Who Conquers the South Yao Fangcheng spoke to Xing: "Bandits are not yet destroyed and the sovereign again lies ill; Wang Tong, Fu Yin and others all retain private troops—they will end as menaces; it is fitting to eliminate them entirely."

units.zh: 興於是誅苻胤、王統、王廣、徐成、毛盛，乃赴召。
units.en: Xing cut down Fu Yin, Wang Tong, Wang Guang, Xu Cheng, and Mao Sheng before riding to camp.
units.literal: Xing then executed Fu Yin, Wang Tong, Wang Guang, Xu Cheng, and Mao Sheng, then answered the summons.

units.zh: 興至，萇怒曰：「王統兄弟是吾州裏，無他遠志，徐成等昔在秦朝，並為名將。
units.en: Chang raged at him: "Wang Tong's clan are neighbors without lofty plots; Xu Cheng's crowd were Qin stars.
units.literal: When Xing arrived Chang angrily said: "The Wang Tong brothers are men of my province without distant ambition; Xu Cheng and others in former Qin times together were famed generals.

units.zh: 天下小定，吾方任之，奈何輒便誅害，令人喪氣！」
units.en: Peace was near and I planned to employ them—why slaughter them and crush morale!"
units.literal: With the realm slightly settled I was about to employ them—how could you rashly slaughter them and chill men's spirits!"

units.zh: 萇下書，兵吏從征伐，戶在大營者，世世復其家，無所豫。
units.en: He exempted forever every household tied to the Great Camp host.
units.literal: Chang issued an edict: soldiers and clerks who followed campaigns and households belonging to the Great Camp shall generation after generation have their families exempted without levies.

units.zh: 苻登與竇沖相持，萇議擊之，尹緯言於萇曰：「太子純厚之稱，著于遐邇，將領英略，未為遠近所知。
units.en: As Deng fenced with Dou Chong, Yin Wei advised, "The heir is loved for kindness but untested as commander.
units.literal: Fu Deng locked horns with Dou Chong; Chang debated striking him; Yin Wei said to Chang: "The crown prince's reputation for purity and generosity is famed far and near; his martial designs are not yet known near and far.

units.zh: 宜遣太子親行，可以漸廣威武，防窺窬之原。」
units.en: Let him lead an army—spread dread abroad and choke intrigue."
units.literal: It is fitting to dispatch the crown prince in person—thus may martial awe gradually broaden and block the springs of covetous intrigue."

units.zh: 萇從之，戎興曰：「賊徒知汝轉近，必相驅入堡，聚而掩之，無不克矣。」
units.en: Chang agreed and coached Xing: "Let Deng learn you march—he will herd his men behind walls; then bundle and crush them."
units.literal: Chang followed this counsel and instructed Xing: "When bandits learn you are drawing near they will surely herd into forts; gather and ambush them—none will withstand you."

units.zh: 比至胡空堡，沖圍自解。
units.en: When Xing neared Hukong Fort, Dou Chong's ring broke without a blow.
units.literal: By the time he reached Hukong Fort, Chong's siege dissolved of itself.

units.zh: 登聞興向胡空堡，引還，興因襲平涼，大獲而歸，咸如萇策。
units.en: Deng heard Xing was bound for Hukong Fort and withdrew; Xing thereupon raided Pingliang, took great booty, and returned—all as Chang had planned.
units.literal: Deng heard Xing was bound for Hukong Fort and withdrew; Xing thereupon raided Pingliang, took great booty, and returned—all as Chang had planned.

units.zh: 使興還鎮長安。
units.en: He returned Xing to the capital garrison.
units.literal: He sent Xing back to guard Chang'an.

units.zh: 萇下書除妖謗之言及赦前奸穢，有相劾舉者，皆以其罪罪之。
units.en: He banned rumor-mongering about portents and forbade recycling old amnesties—false denunciation earns the denouncer's penalty.
units.literal: Chang issued an edict abolishing talk of omens and slander and prior amnesty for foul crimes—whoever impeaches another on these grounds suffers the same crime.

units.zh: 晉平遠將軍、護氐校尉楊佛嵩率胡蜀三千餘戶降于萇，晉將楊佺期、趙睦追之。
units.en: Yang Fosong of Jin brought Di and Shu settlers to Chang; Yang Quanqi and Zhao Mu gave chase.
units.literal: Jin's General Who Pacifies the Distance and Colonel of the Di Yang Fosong led more than three thousand Hu and Shu households to surrender to Chang; Jin generals Yang Quanqi and Zhao Mu pursued.

units.zh: 遣姚崇赴救，大敗晉師，斬趙睦。
units.en: Yao Chong rode to the rescue, shattered the Jin column, and took Zhao Mu's head.
units.literal: Chang sent Yao Chong to rescue; he utterly defeated Jin forces and beheaded Zhao Mu.

units.zh: 以佛嵩為鎮東將軍。
units.en: Fosong became general who guards the east.
units.literal: He appointed Fosong General Who Guards the East.

units.zh: 萇如長安，至於新支堡，疾篤，輿疾而進。
units.en: Bound for Chang'an, he collapsed at Xinzhi Fort and pressed on in a litter.
units.literal: Chang went to Chang'an; reaching Xinzhi Fort his illness turned severe; he advanced by litter though ill.

units.zh: 夢苻堅將天官使者、鬼兵數百突入營中，萇懼，走入宮，宮人迎萇刺鬼，誤中萇陰，鬼相謂曰：「正中死處。」
units.en: He dreamed Fu Jian charged camp with hundreds of sky-clerk ghosts; fleeing indoors, harem women lunged at shades and speared his groin by mistake—the spirits whispered, "Right on the fatal spot."
units.literal: He dreamed Fu Jian led several hundred celestial officials and ghost soldiers bursting into camp; Chang fled in fear into the palace; palace women welcomed Chang and stabbed ghosts but mistakenly struck Chang's groin; the ghosts said to each other: "Right on the fatal spot."

units.zh: 拔矛，出血石餘。
units.en: They wrenched the spear free and blood gushed a stone's weight.
units.literal: They drew the lance; blood flowed more than a stone's measure.

units.zh: 寤而驚悸，遂患陰腫，醫刺之，出血如夢。
units.en: He woke swollen; doctors lanced him and the flow matched the nightmare.
units.literal: Awakening in terror he then suffered groin swelling; physicians lanced it and blood flowed as in the dream.

units.zh: 萇遂狂言，或稱「臣萇，殺陛下者兄襄，非臣之罪，願不枉臣。」
units.en: Delirious, he sometimes cried, "Your minister Chang—he who killed Your Majesty was elder brother Xiang, not my crime; pray do not wrong your minister."
units.literal: Chang then raved, sometimes saying "Your minister Chang—he who killed Your Majesty was elder brother Xiang, not your minister's crime; pray do not wrong your minister."

units.zh: 至長安，召太尉姚旻、尚書左僕射尹緯、右僕射姚晃、尚書狄伯支等入，受遺輔政。
units.en: In Chang'an he summoned Grand Commandant Yao Min, Left Minister Yin Wei, Right Minister Yao Huang, Minister Di Bozhi and others, and charged them as testamentary regents.
units.literal: Reaching Chang'an he summoned Grand Commandant Yao Min, Left Minister Yin Wei, Right Minister Yao Huang, Minister Di Bozhi and others to enter and receive testamentary charge to assist government.

units.zh: 萇謂興曰：「有毀此諸人者，慎勿受之。
units.en: Chang told Xing, "Should anyone slander these men, beware—do not accept it.
units.literal: Chang told Xing: "Should anyone slander these men, beware—do not accept it.

units.zh: 汝撫骨肉以仁，接大臣以禮，待物以信，遇黔首以恩，四者既備，吾無憂矣。」
units.en: Treat flesh-and-blood with kindness, receive great ministers with ritual, deal with things in good faith, treat the common people with kindness—when these four are in place, I have no worry."
units.literal: Treat flesh-and-bone with kindness, receive great ministers with ritual, deal with things with trust, encounter black-haired commoners with kindness—when these four are prepared I have no worry.

units.zh: 以太元十八年死，時年六十四，在位八年。
units.en: He died in Taiyuan 18 at sixty-four, after eight years on the throne.
units.literal: He died in Taiyuan 18 at the age of sixty-four, after reigning for eight years.

units.zh: 偽諡武昭皇帝，廟號太祖，墓稱原陵。
units.en: His false posthumous title was Emperor Wuzhao, temple name Taizu, tomb Yuanling.
units.literal: His false posthumous title was Emperor Wuzhao with temple name Taizu and tomb called Yuanling.
